hint: Any town or city with official town status (Stadt) counts.
boundary: Every current German municipality holding town/city status (Stadt), including the city-states Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen. Villages and non-town municipalities (Wacken, Scheeßel, Weeze) and city districts (Kreuzberg, Schwabing) do not count; nor do former towns since merged into another.

notes: Generated from Wikidata (instance of 'urban municipality of Germany', plus big/independent cities in Germany, not dissolved); display name = enwiki title without its ', Region' disambiguator. Short forms (Frankfurt, Halle, Neustadt…) and umlaut spellings are aliases; a short form shared by several towns goes to the most populous. The big five (Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt) are locked to MAIN STAGE: across 2,000+ towns the pageview long tail dilutes their fame share below what players actually say.
